caption: The Send to / Publish button in the authoring top bar
preconditions: e2e 'main' snapshot (or equivalent): desk 'Sports' with stage 'Working' containing the text item 'story 2'
No features.customAuthoringTopbar configured, so the top bar only shows the default buttons (keeps the shot uncluttered)
steps: Open #/workspace/monitoring
Open 'Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families' for editing from desk 'Politics'
Wait for [data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="open-send-publish-pane"] to be visible
Hover [data-test-id="open-send-publish-pane"] so the 'Send to / Publish' tooltip shows
notes: Button is #send-to-btn in scripts/apps/authoring/views/authoring-topbar.html, tooltip 'Send to / Publish', paper plane icon. If the tooltip does not render in the crop, take the shot without hover. Capture: no outline; the hover tooltip names the button, and a red outline on the purple button is hard to see.

caption: The Send to tab
preconditions: e2e 'main' snapshot: desks 'Sports' and 'Education', each with 'Incoming' and 'Working'; item 'story 2' in Sports / Working
Default client config (ui.sendEmbargo false, authoring.panels.sendTo.publishSchedule false) so the tab shows only Destination and Stage
steps: Open 'Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families' for editing from desk 'Politics'
Click [data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="open-send-publish-pane"]
In [data-test-id="interactive-actions-panel"] click the tab with role=tab name 'Send to' inside [data-test-id="tabs"]
Open [data-test-id="destination-select"] and choose 'Business'
In [data-test-id="stage-select"] check the radio 'Incoming'
Do not click Send
notes: Shows Destination toggle box, Stage radio group and the Send button. 'Send and open' is not shown because the panel was opened from authoring. Optionally take a second variant with the destination dropdown open to show preferred desks listed first (needs the 'desks:preferred' user preference set).

caption: The Publish tab
preconditions: e2e 'main' snapshot: item 'test sports story' in Sports / Working, at least one subscriber ('Subscriber 1')
Sports desk type is Production (or features.noPublishOnAuthoringDesk off) so the Publish tab is available
Default client config: ui.publishEmbargo true, authoring.panels.publish.publishSchedule true, authoring.panels.publish.publishingTarget true, ui.sendAndPublish not set (true)
steps: Open 'Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families' for editing from desk 'Politics'
Click [data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="open-send-publish-pane"]
Make sure the 'Publish' tab is active in [data-test-id="interactive-actions-panel"] [data-test-id="tabs"] (it is the default)
Wait for the 'Target' toggle box button to be visible (panel finished loading)
notes: Sections expected top to bottom: From (desk select), Embargo, Publish schedule, Target (Target subscribers, Target regions, Target types). Footer: Publish from (disabled) and Publish. Preview only appears if a subscriber destination has a preview endpoint URL. If the panel is taller than the viewport, use a 1440x1100 viewport.

caption: Superdesk asks to save your changes before sending or publishing
preconditions: e2e 'main' snapshot: item 'test sports story' in Sports / Working
steps: Open 'Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families' for editing from desk 'Politics'
Change the headline in [data-test-id="field--headline"] (role textbox) to 'Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for young families'
Wait until [data-test-id="authoring-topbar"] [data-test-id="save"] is enabled (edit registered)
Click [data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="open-send-publish-pane"], keep the 'Publish' tab
Click [data-test-id="interactive-actions-panel"] [data-test-id="publish"]
Wait for [data-test-id="modal-confirm"] to be visible
notes: Dialog title 'Save changes?', text 'There are some unsaved changes, do you want to save and send it now?', buttons 'Save and send' and 'Cancel' (ConfirmDirtyService.confirmSendTo). Cancel the dialog afterwards; do not publish.

caption: Embargo, publish schedule and time zone
preconditions: e2e 'main' snapshot: item 'test sports story' in Sports / Working
User has the 'embargo' privilege (admin has it)
Server DEFAULT_TIMEZONE set to a named zone, e.g. Europe/Prague, so the Time zone field is filled in
steps: Open 'Baltrum Energy to raise household tariffs 6 percent in January' for editing from desk 'Business'
open the Send to / Publish panel on the 'Publish' tab
In [data-test-id="embargo"] set the date [data-test-id="date-input"] to tomorrow and the time [data-test-id="time-input"] to 12:00
In [data-test-id="publish-schedule"] set the date to tomorrow and the time to 10:00
Wait for the 'Time zone' toggle box to appear below Publish schedule
notes: The Time zone section only renders once embargo or schedule has a value. Each date field has a round 'Clear' icon button at its end (tooltip 'Clear'). Do not publish; close the panel and discard changes afterwards, or use a throwaway item. Capture: uses the throwaway Business item ENERGY-TARIFFS (Business / Incoming) and clears both dates afterwards, because the panel saves embargo and schedule values to the item.

caption: A scheduled and embargoed item in Monitoring
preconditions: e2e 'main' snapshot with 'Subscriber 1' so publishing succeeds
Item 'story 2' published from desk 'Sports' with Publish schedule tomorrow 10:00 and Embargo tomorrow 12:00 (set in the Publish tab, then Publish, confirm 'Save and send' if asked)
Sports desk monitoring shows the 'Scheduled Desk Output' group (enable it in the desk's monitoring settings if it is not shown)
Client list config shows 'scheduledDateTime', 'state' and 'embargo' in the second line (the default host config does)
steps: Open #/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Sports'
wait until [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Sports"] contains at least one [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Eastbrook Rovers name unchanged side for rugby semifinal"]
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
highlight: [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Sports"] [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Eastbrook Rovers name unchanged side for rugby semifinal"] .label--warning

[data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Sports"] [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Eastbrook Rovers name unchanged side for rugby semifinal"] span[title^="Article is scheduled"]
[data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Sports"] [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Eastbrook Rovers name unchanged side for rugby semifinal"] .state_embargo
notes: If the Scheduled Desk Output group cannot be enabled, crop the article row wherever it appears (e.g. search results). The exact data-test-value for the scheduled output group is unverified; it is built from group.header and group.subheader in monitoring-group.html.

caption: Descheduling several items at once
preconditions: Two items on desk 'Sports' published with a Publish schedule in the future (e.g. 'story 2' and 'test sports story' scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 and 11:00)
Scheduled Desk Output group shown for Sports, or use Search filtered to the two items
steps: Open #/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Sports'
wait until [data-test-id="monitoring-view"] contains at least one [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Aldmark Open final: Brook and Lind meet for the third time"]

hover [data-test-id="article-item"][data-test-value="Aldmark Open final: Brook and Lind meet for the third time"] [data-test-id="item-type-and-multi-select"] and check its [data-test-id="multi-select-checkbox"]
do the same for 'Arlenport Marathon: course record under threat on Sunday'
Wait for [data-test-id="multi-action-bar"] and the inline action [data-test-id="multi-actions-inline"] [data-test-id="Deschedule"]
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
Do not click Deschedule
notes: Bulk action defined in scripts/apps/search/controllers/get-bulk-actions.tsx (label 'Deschedule', calendar icon). Clicking it opens 'Do you want to deschedule articles?'. Capture: opens the Sports Scheduled Desk Output group on its own from the Monitoring dropdown so only scheduled items are in view.
